title: Dangerous Ground
speaker: Ps Andrew Cartledge
blurb:
You can be in the room, sing the songs, give, serve, cry at an altar call, and still be standing on the most dangerous ground there is.

Ps Andrew Cartledge takes a strange detail from a wedding parable in Matthew 22 and refuses to let it stay comfortable. A man who gets invited off the street to a royal feast shows up without wedding clothes. He made it in. He's eating the food. The king calls him "friend," and he has nothing to say. Andrew works through five red flags that might tell you whether that man looks familiar, and not one of them is about how you dress on a Sunday morning.

This is not a sermon about people who walked away from God in a blaze of rebellion. It's about the quieter danger of drifting while the music still plays.
